comparisons.reason: Different constructs. Feature 0 detects first-hand or personally situated details of how work is done: tasks, hours, tools and workplace conditions from the commenter's own or a specific person's work experience. Feature 1 detects a concrete analogy drawn from a specific real-world case, event or fact outside the OP's scenario, used as a comparison. Personal labor experience is not an external analogy, and an analogy need not involve labor or first-hand experience. The positive-match predicates and eligibility rules differ, even though both are any-comment binary features over OC_comments with the same null and empty handling.
